evidence.note: Key credential (client id and secret) is exchanged for a bearer token at /api/v1/oauth/token using client_credentials. This is a custom token exchange, not the Power Query OAuth kind, so it is not counted as oauth.
Otherwise the connector posts to /api/v1/auth/token with no header, relying on the engine to supply the UsernamePassword credentials, then uses the returned token.
Data source kind declares UsernamePassword and Key authentication.
The client_id and client_secret derived from the Key credential are sent in the form-urlencoded request body of the token call.

Requests send page-size and page index parameters, so the paging is offset-style with a limit.
The page count is derived from totalCount divided by PAGE_SIZE.

Pages are produced by List.Transform over the list {0..totalPagesCount - 1}, not by Table.GenerateByPage, List.Generate or recursion. The same pattern appears in computers (349-353), mobileDevices (417-423), mobileDeviceApplications (473-477), computerExtensionAttributes (506-511) and mobileDeviceExtensionAtttributes (566-570).

paging-stop.text: Paging stops after the page count computed from the first request's totalCount (ceil(totalCount / PAGE_SIZE), or 0 when totalCount is 0). The connector requests pages 0 through count minus 1 and does not read any next link or token.

retry-rule.text: Any non-200 response is retried, including 429 and 401 (both in ManualStatusHandling). Each retry refreshes the token with TokenAuthorizationHeader(baseUrl, true). Retries stop when attempts reach 3 total (number_of_attempts < 3). Each retry waits #duration(0,0,0,3), which is 3 seconds. Response headers are read but unused, so there is no Retry-After handling.

evidence.note: Retry condition responseCode <> 200 and attempts below 3, with a 3-second InvokeAfter delay and a token refresh.
